answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond through a three-epoch maturation horizon, weightless until then; the sable ledger records bond, start epoch, and key binding. Each epoch needs one verified delivery plus 5 upkeep for one pearl mark; three marks activate the bond. Missed upkeep or failure resets the clock. The k-th fake needs a k-th bond and upkeep stream: 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 5,000 per epoch, 95,000 over maturation, versus 95 for one honest identity. Rented maturation fails: a bought account breaks its key binding, the sable ledger exposes the mismatch and burns the bond.
